title: Welcome back — try it in a test window

steps.path: A test window of YouCoded, separate from yours
steps.headline: Open two sessions, type in both, close the window with the switch ON, reopen: are both offered back?
steps.changed: The test window runs the finished feature for real. Sessions you start in it are real conversations and sync like any other, so keep them short (e.g. 'hi').
steps.notice: Close the window, turn on 'Resume on Next Launch?', press Close window, then press Open the dev window again. Welcome back should list both, ticked; Resume all reopens them.
steps.risk: It is a second window on your desktop; your own YouCoded is not touched.

steps.headline: Close one session with its X, then close the window with the switch OFF, reopen: does it open on the normal start screen?
steps.changed: Two ways a session is deliberately let go: its own X, and closing the window with the switch left off.
steps.notice: No Welcome back screen this time; the sessions are still in Resume Session.

steps.path: A second test window with its own separate settings
steps.headline: With sessions left open in the first test window, open this second one: does it NOT offer them?
steps.changed: This window stands in for your other computer: it keeps its own list, so it must not offer the first window's sessions.
steps.notice: Leave a session open in the first test window and quit it from its menu (or let it be), then open this one: it opens on the normal start screen.
